farmBuilds.name: 5-2-0 Banana Central
farmBuilds.note: Estimate: 5 crates at Central value with Valuable Bananas; also buffs all BRFs +25%.

farmBuilds.name: 0-2-3 Marketplace
farmBuilds.note: 16 auto packets/round. Banana Salvage + Marketplace bonus give boosted sellback.

farmBuilds.name: 0-2-4 Central Market
farmBuilds.note: 16 × $70 base ($1,120) before middle-path bonus; each CM also buffs Merchantmen +10%.

farmBuilds.name: 0-2-3 Merchantman
farmBuilds.note: $200/round base (wiki). Middle crosspath adds Grape/Hot Shot defense.

farmBuilds.name: 0-2-4 Favored Trades
farmBuilds.note: $500/round; boosts sellback of nearby towers. Prioritized by Trade Empire.

farmBuilds.name: 0-0-5 Trade Empire
farmBuilds.note: $800/round itself + buffs up to 20 boats. Worth it from ~16 Merchantmen.

farmBuilds.name: 2-3-0 Monkey Bank
farmBuilds.note: Effective $/rd incl. interest — must be collected manually. Upgrade to IMF for loans.

strategies.title: Land Meta
points: Core: 4-2-0 BRF spam once you can afford ~$27k each; they out-earn Marketplaces per farm slot.
Add one 5-2-0 Banana Central when you own 6+ BRFs — the +25% crate buff pays for itself fast.
Rotate an Overclock (Engineer 0-4-0) onto a BRF to boost its production; Ultraboost for permanent gains.
Use Marketplaces as a stepping stone and sell them into BRF upgrades.

strategies.title: Hands-off
points: 0-2-3 / 0-2-4 Marketplaces auto-collect every packet — no tapping, no missed bananas.
Boosted sellback (default ~85% in the calculator — confirm on your patch) means you lose little when you liquidate before a boss tier.
Central Markets also give every Merchantman +10% (stacks 10×), bridging into the water meta.
Healthy Bananas MK: Marketplaces/Central Markets generate lives — useful vs. Lych.

strategies.title: Water Meta
points: Spam 0-2-3 Merchantmen (cheap, discountable with Monkey Commerce) — $200/rd each.
At ~16 boats, buy 0-0-5 Trade Empire: +$10 per Merchantman / +$20 per Favored Trades to up to 20 boats, plus damage.
Upgrade to 0-2-4 Favored Trades once 20 Merchantmen exist; 10 Central Markets double Merchantman income.
0-0-4 Monkey City villages near the fleet stack discounts and cash bonuses before Monkeyopolis.

strategies.title: Active Tricks
points: 2-4-0 IMF Loan: take the loan right before a big buy, repay automatically from income — ideal before a boss tier spike.
Cycle: Loan → buy DPS → bank refills → collect at cap → loan again when off cooldown.
Monkeyopolis (0-0-5 Village) absorbs farms in its radius and converts their value into crates — space farms inside the circle before buying it.
Sacrificing expensive 4-x-x farms gives the best absorption value per farm.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Camo + lead coverage, one MOAB answer (Bomb 2-3-0/Sniper 2-0-2), Ice Embrittlement if affordable.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Keep farming; buy first BRF or 4–6 Marketplaces.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Main single-target carry at T4 (Sniper 4-0-2 / Sub 2-0-4), Alch 4-0-1, Village MIB.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Transition Marketplaces → BRFs; Trade Empire on water.

bossCheckpoints.defense: First T5 damage (Super Brittle, MOAB Eliminator or Sun Temple), Overclock rotation.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Banana Central; consider selling some eco before the boss spawns.

bossCheckpoints.defense: 2+ T5 carries, full buff stack (Alch, Village 2-3-0/2-4-0, Ice debuff), Geraldo items.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Liquidate low-ROI farms before spawn; keep BRFs only if the boss can be stalled.

bossCheckpoints.defense: Paragon or several T5s + Monkey Knowledge/Powers as allowed by the event.
bossCheckpoints.economy: Sell remaining eco into damage at the end of R119.
